title: The Middle East – being there.
excerpt: This insightful article by Lynne Hybels mirrors my own experience – and the diverse responses in the comments section mirror the range of views, attitudes, approaches to the Bible, and assumptions about God that I encounter whenever I address this subject as well. Worth reading.
